title: Introduction to Quarters Using Circular Cut-outs

studentJourney.title: Welcome to Quarters
studentJourney.content: Amina has one round chapati to share fairly with 4 people.
studentJourney.owlText: Hello, explorer! Amina has one round chapati to share fairly with 4 people. How can she make sure everyone gets the same amount?
studentJourney.studentText: Amina wants to be fair. If one person gets a bigger piece, the sharing will not be equal. Let us help her split the chapati into 4 equal parts.
studentJourney.storyIntro: Today, you will learn how to split one whole into 4 equal parts. Each part is called one quarter.

studentJourney.title: Your Mission
studentJourney.content: Help Amina share one whole chapati equally among 4 people.
studentJourney.owlText: Help Amina find the fair way to share among 4! Then you will learn the special name for each piece.
studentJourney.studentText: Amina needs to share one chapati among 4 people. Find the fair way to split it.

visualSpec.title: Your mission has 4 parts:
visualSpec.missionIntro: Amina needs to share one chapati among 4 people. Help her find the fair way.
items: Check that all 4 pieces are the same size.
Learn that one equal part is called one quarter.

feedbackSpec.correct: Mission accepted! Let us discover quarters together.

studentJourney.title: Think First
studentJourney.content: Before we learn the rule, look carefully. Which picture shows a fair way to share one chapati among 4 people?
studentJourney.owlText: Look carefully. Fair sharing means everyone gets the same size piece. Which picture shows 4 equal parts?
studentJourney.studentText: Which picture shows a fair way to share one chapati among 4 people?

visualSpec.prompt: Which picture shows a fair way to share one chapati among 4 people?
visualSpec.instruction: Choose the picture where all 4 pieces are the same size.

feedbackSpec.correct: Yes! Four equal parts means each person gets exactly the same amount. That is fair!
feedbackSpec.incorrect: Look carefully. We need exactly 4 equal parts for 4 people.

studentJourney.title: What Is One Quarter?
studentJourney.content: When we split one whole into 4 equal parts, each part is called one quarter. We write one quarter as 1/4. 1/4 means 1 part out of 4 equal parts.
studentJourney.owlText: Let us see how one whole chapati becomes one quarter, step by step.
studentJourney.studentText: Follow these steps to see how one whole becomes one quarter.

visualSpec.intro: Follow these steps to see how one whole becomes one quarter.

steps.title: Fold in half
steps.description: Fold the chapati into 2 equal parts. Each part is one half.

steps.title: Fold again into 4
steps.description: Fold it again. Now you have 4 equal parts.

steps.title: One quarter
steps.description: One of the 4 equal parts is one quarter.

steps.title: Write it as 1/4
steps.description: We write: 1/4 means 1 part out of 4 equal parts.

studentJourney.title: Find the Quarter
studentJourney.content: Which picture correctly shows 1/4? Look carefully at how many equal parts each shape has.
studentJourney.owlText: Time to test your eyes! Only one picture shows a true quarter.

visualSpec.instruction: Choose the picture where one quarter is shaded.

feedbackSpec.correct: Yes! 1/4 means 1 out of 4 equal parts. Well done!
feedbackSpec.incorrect: Not quite. Remember: a quarter needs exactly 4 EQUAL parts.

studentJourney.title: Worked Example: Make a Quarter
studentJourney.content: Let us make one quarter using circular paper. Follow each step.
studentJourney.owlText: I will show you how to fold paper into 4 equal parts!
studentJourney.studentText: Follow these steps to make one quarter from paper.

visualSpec.intro: Follow these steps to make one quarter from circular paper.

steps.title: Start with a circle
steps.description: Start with one whole paper circle.

steps.title: Fold it in half
steps.description: Fold the circle so the edges meet perfectly. You now have 2 equal parts.

steps.title: Fold it again
steps.description: Fold the half in half again. Now you have 4 equal parts.

steps.title: Open and shade one quarter
steps.description: Open it up. You see 4 equal parts. Shade 1 part to show 1/4.

studentJourney.title: Your Turn
studentJourney.owlText: Time to practice! Show me you can find a quarter.
studentJourney.studentText: Look at these shapes. Which one shows one quarter?

feedbackSpec.incorrect: Try again. Look for 4 equal parts with only 1 shaded.

studentJourney.title: Quick Check
studentJourney.content: One more question! Which picture correctly shows 1/4?
studentJourney.owlText: Let me check if you truly understand quarters!

visualSpec.instruction: Pick the one that is truly one quarter.

feedbackSpec.correct: Yes! You understand one quarter perfectly!
feedbackSpec.incorrect: Not quite. Remember: 1/4 needs exactly 4 EQUAL parts.

studentJourney.title: Think About It
studentJourney.content: You did great! Now think about what you learned.
studentJourney.owlText: How do you know when a part is one quarter?

studentJourney.title: Lesson Complete
studentJourney.content: Great job! You learned that one quarter is 1 part out of 4 equal parts. We write one quarter as 1/4. You helped Amina share fairly!
studentJourney.owlText: Fantastic work today! You are now a quarter expert!
studentJourney.studentText: You completed the lesson! Well done!
